speaker: A
name: Alex
text: Honestly, I'm not really a city person, and I don't like this city — but that doesn't mean I hate it.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: I just don't like it, you know.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: I grew up in the southern part of China, so I never got used to it here: it's too cold in winter and too dry.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: Also, the prices are higher — things here cost more than where I used to live.
